summary: The Gateway now appends safe prose to the projected live reply after a directive settles, avoiding repeated full-reply parsing.
reasoning: I checked #158489 and its parent: the old Gateway path parsed the complete buffer whenever it projected changed live text, and #158489 introduced an incremental projector that retained that work after a prose marker. Path history shows that #183198 moved the same condition into the stream module. The fix reduced measured parser work while delivering byte-identical text, and the reported timings did not establish a user-visible slowdown.
